Q1.text: Dis survey go help us understand your health needs and make sure your community get things like medicine, delivery packs, sanitary pads, contraceptives and free treatment when flood come. Your answers dey private. We fit start?

Q2.text: Wetin be the name of your State and Community?

Q7.text: How much you dey earn per year?

Q8.text: Which type house you dey stay?

Q9.text: How many people dey your family?

Q10.text: You get any disability? If yes, wetin e be?

Q11.text: You don dey see any of these things recently? Tick as many as apply.

options.discharge: Strange flow or smell from your private part
options.sores: Sore, lump, or blister for mouth or private part
options.burning: Hot or burning feeling when you dey piss
options.pain_sex: Pain or blood when you dey knack or after you knack
options.fever: Fever or plenty sweating at night
options.yellow_eyes: Yellow eyes/skin or your piss very dark

Q12.text: How long dis thing don dey happen?

Q13.text: The symptoms — e dey get worse, abi e dey the same or e dey get better?

options.same: Na the same thing till now

Q14.text: When last you go do blood test for HIV or other infections?

Q15.text: You get who you dey sleep with since last year?

Q16.text: How many times you dey use condom?

Q17.text: Recently, anybody don force or pressure you to sleep with them when you no want?

Q18.text: You don exchange your body for money, food, gift, or place to stay?

Q19.text: Person wey you dey sleep with get other partners, or any health wahala wey you know?

Q20.text: You dey use any protection for STI or to prevent pregnancy?

options.want_but_no_access: I wan use but I no get

Q21.text: Which one you dey use? Tick all that apply.

Q23.text: How many months you don carry belle?

Q24.text: When last you go for antenatal checkup for dis pregnancy?

Q25.text: Wetin dey stop you from going for antenatal?

options.not_aware: I no know wetin be antenatal service

Q26.text: You don experience any of these for dis pregnancy or past pregnancies? Tick all that apply.

options.swelling: Swelling for leg, hand, or face
options.blurred_vision: Blurred vision (you no dey see well)

Q27.text: How old you be when you first get belle?

options.under_18_or_over_35: Less than 18 years or more than 35 years

Q28.text: Wetin be the space between your pikin (if you get 2 or more pikin)?

options.over_2_years: More than 2 years apart or I only get one pikin

Q29.text: If you dey carry belle now, where you wan born your baby?

Q30.text: You dey prepare for delivery but you no get Delivery Pack (soap, gloves, wrapper, baby clothes, cap, socks, towel, delivery pad) ready?

Q31.text: Where you born your other pikin? (If you no dey carry belle now but you don born before)

Q32.text: You don ever lose pregnancy before (miscarriage)?

Q33.text: If yes, how many times you don lose pregnancy?

Q34.text: Which group of people face SRHR risk the most when flood come? Tick all that apply.

Q35.text: When flood come, which of these things dey available for temporary shelters? You fit tick more than one.

options.privacy: Private place for women and girls

Q36.text: When flood happen, people dey report gender-based violence for your community?

Q37.text: Which of these things you don see for the health centre wey dey your community? Tick all that apply.

options.private_rooms: Private room for testing and talking

Q38.text: The health centre dey near you?

Q39.text: When flood dey happen, you fit still reach the nearest health centre, or road dey block?

options.yes: I fit still reach the health centre

Q40.text: Medicine dey available during past flood?

Q41.text: If you get pikin under 5 years, any of dem don miss their vaccination recently because of flood?

Q42.text: If person force you sleep with them, you fit get help or medicine within 3 days (to prevent HIV, STI or pregnancy)?

Q43.text: Dem dey send warning for your area before flood come?

Q44.text: Abeg drop your phone or WhatsApp number so that relief teams fit reach you with supplies or health support when flood come. (Optional)

Q45.text: E okay make dem use your answers (we no go put your name) to tell relief teams to bring medicine and more health workers to your community before the flood?

PS1.text: How easy the questions be to understand?

PS2.text: How well the words wey dem use to describe sickness, symptoms, or body parts match wetin people dey call dem for dis community?

PS3.text: How well the questions for dis survey show the real health problems wey dey worry you, your family and the community?

PS4.text: You get any other suggestion to make dis survey better or capture the community health situation more accurately?

PS5.text: Any health issue or local thing wey dis survey miss entirely?
